reference.frame: CAD body axes at reference pose, +Y up; current link-local axes for link1/2/3 wrenches
reference.moment_reference: hull and base0 about Ob; links about original uvms_geometry link reference points, NOT shifted new-CAD rigid-body COMs
reference.uncertainty_note: Population SD (ddof=0) of correlated saved samples in the last 200 solver iterations; solver-load fluctuation, NOT independent measurement uncertainty, standard error, discretization error or an uncertainty confidence interval.
reference.joint_tau_convention: J^T times link-local fluid wrenches; current posed axes, not q0 tau_j reports
reference.linear_velocity_sign: body relative to water; minus steady inlet

scaling.rule: half diagonal of hull geometric bounding box; independent of fitted load labels

constraint_diagnostics.allocation_statement: Training-RMS weighted equality-constrained minimum norm; no partial-wall reciprocity assumption.

limitations: Development fit to six existing q0 whole-domain laminar oscillations; not independent-case or blind validation.
Only fixed-arm base-twist observation subspace; no full 9x9 independent-joint added-mass identification.
2 s nominal period, 0.02 m translation / 0.05 rad rotation, 0.5 s ramp only; frequency and amplitude generalization unvalidated.
Velocity-phase response is local laminar effective damping, not a replacement for steady SST drag.
PSD/reciprocity imposed only on aggregate six-base response; partial-wall maps need not be reciprocal or individually passive.
Coriolis term is a coordinate/energy-consistent model completion, not an independently identified nonlinear term.
DC and second-harmonic nuisance terms are diagnostics only and are excluded from deployed predictions.
No startup fluid-memory states are identified; the first 80 unfitted onset samples have materially larger residuals than the last two cycles.
Cycle 2 fit / cycle 3 prediction is a repeated-cycle consistency check, not an independent-case generalization test.
Original87 has a combined hull+base0 residual block; separate legacy hull/base0 predictions are unavailable.
